mixed.label: Near quartz, far magma: the flow must take the diggable vein
mixed.explanation: The borg can dig magma but not quartz, and has twitched past the threshold that lowers the vein gate to magma. The original commits toward the near quartz vein it can never dig (step 8); the correction skips it and commits toward the magma vein (step 6).

  the_committed_vein_must_be_diggable  DECISION rc=1 keys="8"
TRACK # Flowing toward vein at cost 3

magma-only.label: Only the magma vein: unchanged control
magma-only.explanation: With the quartz vein removed, both variants commit to the diggable magma vein (step 6) and the complete log is byte-identical.

capable.label: Every vein diggable: unchanged control
capable.explanation: A borg with a wielded Shovel and digging 60 passes the per-target check on both variants, mines the near quartz vein (step 8) as before, and the complete log is byte-identical.
